description: Simulated handheld camera recoil on impact — fast violent shake decaying to residual tremor. Adds physicality and ground-level presence.

orchestration_stages.label: Pre-Event Micro Float
orchestration_stages.description: Very subtle camera float before impact — simulates handheld breathing.
orchestration_hints: Random noise on all three axes + rotation.
artistic_constraints: Must be subtle — not obvious. Sets up 'handheld' feel.

orchestration_stages.label: Impact Violent Shake
orchestration_stages.description: Maximum displacement on impact frame — violent high-frequency shake.
artistic_constraints: Impact frame must have maximum displacement.
Camera rotation displacement: 1–5 degrees on impact.
Both translation and rotation must shake.

orchestration_stages.label: Decay Oscillation
orchestration_stages.description: Shake decays from high-frequency violent to low-frequency residual tremor.
artistic_constraints: Decay must feel physically weighted — not linear falloff.
Frequency should drop during decay — high-to-low.

orchestration_stages.label: Residual Tremor Settle
orchestration_stages.description: Final residual camera tremor — camera does not return to exact pre-impact position.
artistic_constraints: Camera must NOT return exactly to pre-impact position.
Residual tremor persists minimum 60 frames after peak.

review_expectations.impact: Maximum displacement on impact frame. Violent and immediate.
review_expectations.decay: Physically weighted decay. Not linear. Frequency drops.
review_expectations.residual: Residual tremor persists 60+ frames. Camera has permanent drift.
review_expectations.rotation: Both translation and rotation shake — not just translation.
review_expectations.feel: Feels physical and grounded — not procedural or uniform.
